ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible ventral surface is composed almost entirely of low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels with no high-intensity (white) pigmentation patches present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 105 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) of approximately 5-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric bi-lobed sweep exhibiting concavity near the median notch and transitioning to an upward convex curve towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of textured white and tan pixels located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent epibiotic clusters (barnacles) visible at the lateral margins of both lobes.
